name: Yuuya Akizuki
source:
Having met in college, Yuuya has always been the guy to turn to when you need someone to cover your back. Whilst his direct and blunt personality might give him a bit of an edge, it’s clear he takes being your friend seriously – perhaps more so than his actual job.

Despite seemingly always one step ahead, Yuuya is always keen to help you get used to the world of work, whilst all the while dishing out fresh servings of questionable advice when it comes to relationships.
